biotools.summary: ARTEM-IS for ERP is a tool that provides a standardized reporting template for EEG methodology, specifically for Event-Related Potential experiments. It supports documenting methodological information and generates human-readable PDF/DOCX and machine-readable JSON summaries, improving transparency and reproducibility.
